title: Axiom Prover formalization identifies a missing case in a published group classification
summary: Axiom reports that formalizing a 2019 theorem about automorphism groups of curves exposed an omission in its printed list. The group SL(2,3) occurs for a specific curve and was already present in the original authors’ computation.

evidence.tested: Axiom reports the correction and gives an explicit example.
evidence.unknown: The result is a correction to the published statement. The original computation already included the group.
evidence.ai_role: Axiom Prover was used to formalize results against the Lean finite simple group classification corpus and identify the discrepancy.
